notes.title: 1.0 Launch Major Feature Changelog, 1.0 Out Now!
notes.content:
[h1][i][b]1.0 has finally launched.[/b][/i][/h1]

[h2][b]Make entry, officers![/b][/h2]

In the [b]changelog below[/b] we will cover most of the [b]major feature changes[/b] that have been introduced into [b]Ready or Not 1.0[/b], although [b]not exhaustive[/b] due to changes spanning almost 12 months. 

[b]Bugfixes are not listed[/b]— rest assured that there are[b] too many to count[/b] here.

We will [b]continue to hotfix[/b] the 1.0 update in the coming days and look forward to [b]far more updates in the bright future for Ready or Not![/b]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Gameplay[/b][/u][/h2]

[list][*] Commander mode: “Commander mode” is our immersive Ready or Not single player experience. The mode acts to tie together all elements of the game’s existing design, as well as introducing new features centered around progression and replayability. We will be heavily monitoring feedback surrounding this mode.

[list][*] Ironman Mode: A permadeath-style option for hardcore players. Once you’re dead, your save is deleted. There are cosmetic rewards for completing this mode.
[*]Exfiltration Mechanic: In order to quit a mission early without accruing as much stress to their officers, players must exfil from their spawn point, being sure to first backtrack safely.
[*] Save Slots: 3 save slots have been added that will allow players to experiment with different runs, or for multiple users on one PC.
[*] Stress System: A meta-game stress system that punishes the team for acting outside of the Use of Force continuum, or otherwise putting lives in danger. Officers at high stress will have to be benched and put on therapy, or be at risk of leaving the team permanently.
[*] Officer Traits: ~12 modifiers that affect your officer or team composition to benefit your select playstyle. Traits become available for each respective officer as you play missions with them.[/list][/list][list][*] New SWAT AI: A remarkable next-generation AI system capable of clearing rooms in a truly lifelike fashion, built from the ground-up by working closely with our SWAT advisory team.

[list][*] New AI and Team Commands: A number of new commands are now available for ordering AI (and now your friends) around.
[list][*] Officers will be able to order surrendered and arrested targets to turn around, move to a marked position, or move to the officer’s location. 
[*] AI can be told to run to the nearest exit and flee the location. They will be automatically arrested upon arrival there.
[*] Commands are now able to be used in cooperative, so players without microphones can communicate a little easier with other player teammates. 
[list][*]  This system is pending some QOL improvements such as UI elements to help see what has been marked. Some commands will also default to Judge’s voice.[/list][/list][/list][list][*] Police Trailer Units: Automated trailer units have also been added, which are police units that come in after a mission to collect arrested contacts and any relevant people or items. This will occur when “bring order to chaos” is completed.[/list][/list][list][*] New Tablet System: Objectives and other elements of the UI that were previously non-diegetic have been moved to the Tablet, which is able to be opened by pressing “TAB” by default.

[list][*] After selecting a mission, players can: Listen to a situation briefing and 911 calls 
[list][*] Receive a list of objectives relevant to the mission
[*] Preview images that might provide some insight into the threat level
[*] Read through a list of known suspects and civilians
[*] Access whatever maps the LSPD has available on the location, with the ability to draw and make plans with your team
[*] Players can also preview their team cameras and loadouts in this tablet, as well as chat with other players using a built-in screen
[/list][/list][/list][list][*]New level selection screen with updated visuals and entry point selection.

[list][*] Ability to pick which mission type to play a level on has been removed due to limitations with design and testing, and to avoid narrative conflicts.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] New Evidence Locker: Collectibles in the Evidence Locker will become available as different missions are completed. Each mission has three: one for B, one for A, and one for S. The collectibles will often point to elements of the story or allude to other details.
[/list][list]
[*] 15 Steam Achievements: 15 challenging achievements are available to completionist players upon release.
[/list][list]
[*] Replay Viewer: Missions can be replayed using a viewer that is accessible in the main menu. This viewer allows for players to change camera aperture settings, color grading settings, focal length, spline paths, and speed. A timeline also exists which can be scrubbed back and forth. 

[list][*] The selection UI for replays is currently WIP, but can be used. 
[*] Replays are accessible from commander, cooperative, and practice mode gameplay. Will also work with mods.
[/list][/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Visuals[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New Character Customization: Allows players to change boots, shirts, pants, armor, gloves, wristwear, heads, tattoos, voices, face-wear, NVGs, gas masks, and helmets (along with mod support for players). 
[*] New Characters Added: Over 175 new characters have been added to the game for suspects, civilians, and other NPCs.
[*] Overhauled Visual Effects: All visual effects have been completely redone. This includes 3D muzzle flashes, impact effects, spalling, destruction, flashbangs, cs gas, pepper spray, OC launcher impacts, tracers, C2 breaches, and much more.
[*] Tip Screens for new players in the Los Suenos Police Station. Information about new unlocks will also be able to be seen here.
[*] Replaced a large number of placeholder assets with more bespoke, custom assets with better optimization.
[*] Headcam perspective now includes the officer’s helmet.
[*] Low Ready Toggle: New options to set high and low ready.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Animations[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New Death Animations: added 100+ death animations (different limbs, arterial bleeds, etc.)
[*] General animation improvements for footsteps, polish, removal of some sliding.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Audio[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] Quantum Sound Manager: New system that supports accurate reflections for sound and better simulated occlusion, leading to a more realistic experience when trying to locate targets. 

[list][*] Audio will also sound different when behind an open or closed door, or when behind a window depending on if it is broken or not.[/list][/list][list]
[*] New distance layers for gunshots: Allows for a nicer transition as enemies get closer while shooting.
[/list][list]
[*] New OSTs added: Plenty of new soundtracks for your listening pleasure.

[list][*] Hospital
[*] Coyote
[*] Streamer
[*] Importer
[*] Sins
[*] Gas
[*] Farm
[*] Beachfront
[*]Valley / Dealer / Penthouse have all been updated so their OSTs are more dynamic (combat comes in more gradually / certain sections “unlock” once certain things happen)[/list][/list][list]
[*] New Sound Design Pass: All levels (old and new) have received improvements to their sound design
[*] New SWAT Voices: 13 uniquely voiced, studio-quality voice lines for different tactical officers operating in the LSPD. 
[*] New Suspect and Civilian Voices: Fully added all remaining voice lines for key characters across each level, with over 50,000 voice lines across more than 120 characters.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Weapons[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New MCX Assault Rifle
[*] New LVAR Assault Rifle
[*] New F90 Assault Rifle
[*] New SuperbNova Shotgun
[*] New UMP-9 SMG
[*] New TLE-1911 Pistol
[*] New TPL Less Lethal Launcher
[*] New X2 Taser
[*] Overhauled 870MCS Breaching Shotgun
[*] Overhauled UMP-45 SMG
[*] Overhauled M45A1 Pistol
[*] Overhauled MPX SMG
[*] Added MK18 Training Version for Tutorial Level
[*] Added G19 Training Version for Tutorial Level
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]User Interface and Experience[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New Main Menu presentation
[*] New Settings Menu presentation
[*] Customization and Loadout Screen Overhauled
[*] Pause Menu Overhauled
[*] Mod.io changed to use a native explorer which has more options (e.g. search by categories)
[*] Added support for subtitles: Shows real-time transcripts of voice lines said in-game.
[*] Colourblind options for protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.
[*] Item Highlight: Item highlights can be enabled for an easier time when finding evidence [/list][list][*] Localization additions: New language support for in-game texts.
[list][*] English
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] French
[*] New Zealand “Kiwi” Dialect [/list][/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Levels[/b][/u][/h2]

[list]
[*] New Map: “Elephant”, an active-shooter mission at a college campus.
[*] New Map: “Rust Belt”, a raid set on the border of Los Sueños and Tijuana.
[*] New Map: “Sins”, a high-stakes hostage situation in the upper floors of an old hotel.
[*] New Map: “Streamer”, a hostage situation occurring in an apartment complex.
[*] New Map: “Beachfront”, a warrant service on a house near Los Sueños' coastline.
[*] New Map: “Training”, an introductory space to players new to Ready or Not or who need a refresher [*] New Map: “Station” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. It includes new spaces such as an improved training area, shooting range with working targets, evidence room, and minigame (although you’ll have to search the halls for this one).

[list][*] Station will progressively change as you complete commander mode missions.[/list][/list][list]
[*] New Map: “Carriers of the Vine” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. Raid a cultist compound and uncover its secrets.
[*] New Map: “Hide and Seek” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. Go head-to-head against a large international criminal operation.[/list][list]
[*] Complete Redesign: “Buy Cheap, Buy Twice” has been recreated almost entirely.[/list][list]
[*] Gameplay Improvements: Level design across all levels has been improved, fixing holes in walls and navigation for AI which would often lead to players being shot through walls and floors. Similarly, navigation through some areas has been adjusted so that it becomes more obvious where players need to go.

[list][*] “Thank You, Come Again” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Twisted Nerve” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Relapse” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Neon Tomb” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Ides of March” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “A Lethal Obsession” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Greased Palms” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Sinuous Trail” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “The Spider” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
[*] “Valley of the Dolls” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility. [/list][/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][u][b]Improvements[/b][/u][/h2]

[list][*]If you are running mods, there will be a new “safe launch” option in case any existing mods are crashing the game.[/list][list]
[*] Overhauled all suspect and civilian AI: This has been done across all levels to make them feel unique to each situation. There are many new details that should allow the AI to appear more intelligent, as well as some unique tells that may give players insight into a situation before they spot any threats. Some of these include:

[list][*] Suspects making less noise upon hearing the player, opting to try and surprise players
[*] Suspect repositioning in combat to take up unexpected angles or corners of rooms.
[*] Civilians surrendering more easily, and occasionally surrendering when suspects are within sight (depending on the level).
[*] More sensible changes to decision making when it comes to surrendering, fake surrendering, fleeing, or initiating combat.
[*] AI flinching reactions have been improved: AI can still return fire and move while lightly flinching, and can move while heavy flinches are playing, but cannot return fire.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Optimization Pass: Many levels have received a pass on their optimization, which should result in a solid FPS on most hardware. Other optimizations include:

[list][*] Game size has been slashed in half from almost 100gb to ~60gb.
[*] Improved settings efficacy: View distance will now cull objects correctly. This is still a work-in-progress, but there are some improvements made.
[*] Dynamic shadow improvements and reduction: Reduced the number of dynamic shadows on some levels, and where appropriate changed these to spotlights, which are generally more ideal for performance.
[*] Visibility culling pass: Many levels have received a large visibility culling pass to improve FPS in areas that are dense with meshes.
[*] [i]Note that optimization changes are ongoing and there are still many improvements to be made.[/i]
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Ammunition Overhaul: Ammunition has been updated for all weapons, and numerous bugs have been obliterated in the wake of this new set of changes:

[list][*] Slug rounds for shotguns will now penetrate most surfaces, as well as up to level 3 armor. They will also ricochet more.
[*] Buckshot and some other rounds will have a chance to severely dismember targets.
[list][*] Players will not be able to arrest a suspect/civilian missing an arm or arms.[/list][*] Some rounds will now have a higher change of causing arterial bleeds.
[*] Fixed issue where some weapons had the wrong ammunition tag, causing it to use default penetration values.
[*] Re-balanced the damage and armor penetration for each ammunition type to make them more logically consistent and each round more uniquely purposed.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Armor Improvements:

[list][*] Armor is now more consistent in gameplay. Incoming rounds will be blocked based on the direction the player is facing, not their 3d model.
[*] Ceramic now has higher durability, but can still break and loses effectiveness with repeated impacts. Don't get blasted by a shotgun. [/list][*] Penetration Overhaul: We have now made several significant improvements, including:

[list][*] Bullets will do less damage depending on the amount of energy left in the round (eg. shooting through several sheets of plywood will reduce the bullet damage)
[*] Flesh is now less easy to penetrate so JHP rounds are more likely to function as intended.
[*] Shooting an enemy through two legs used to do the same amount of damage as the bullet made two different impacts on the same target. Now, it will do reduced damage on the second (and third) hit.
[*] A large number of bugs related to penetration have now been resolved, as well as several large oversights to do with materials that could not be penetrated.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Overhauled Loadout Menu: The new loadout menu provides more insight into item selection, less nested menus, and a simpler way of navigating around different areas.[/list][list]
[*] Ready Up is now done through pressing “Y” by default. 

[list][*] Players no longer need to stand in a specific area, and can be anywhere in the station when readying up
[*] A majority will start the countdown timer 
[*] If all players ready up, the timer will cut down to 10 seconds before starting
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Chemical Agents Improvements: Rebalance, redesign, and refactor of the chemical-based weapons and tools in the game to be more fun and in-depth. Chemical Agents refer to all chemical-based weapons and tools and grenades in the game: CS Gas, OC Balls, Pepperspray.

[list][*] AI will attempt to flee areas that are affected by OC.
[*] AI will stumble and move away from OC when hit by it.
[*] Suspects that are pepper sprayed can still shoot you, but are blinded. 
[*] CS Gas will seep out of open doorways and around corners.
[/list][/list][list]
[*] Fine tuning of “stress” system: allow for positive feedback loop when playing using less-lethal weapons. Suspects (on levels where appropriate) will be more likely to hesitate at low stress levels. Stress increases as more firefights and other loud noises occur.
[*] Use of Force Continnium (aka RoE in-game) has been made more lenient for hostile situations.
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[h2][b]Other[/b][/h2]

[b][i]Literally hundreds of bugs that have been resolved. Too many to list here.[/i][/b]

[h2][b]Known Issues[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*]We noticed some issues with localisations for the French, German,  simplified Chinese, Czech, and Korean language updates and are still diligently working on a fix which will be included in the upcoming hotfixes
[*] Changing language requires game restart
[*] The mission end screen upon death currently prevents the player from spectating their SWAT AI
[*]Comprehensive language expansions for Spanish, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian and Turkish are due to temporal constraints not included in the 1.0 release but will be included in the upcoming hotfixes
[/list]

New Tablet System: Objectives and other elements of the UI that were previously non-diegetic have been moved to the Tablet, which is able to be opened by pressing “TAB” by default.
New level selection screen with updated visuals and entry point selection.

New Evidence Locker: Collectibles in the Evidence Locker will become available as different missions are completed. Each mission has three: one for B, one for A, and one for S. The collectibles will often point to elements of the story or allude to other details.
15 Steam Achievements: 15 challenging achievements are available to completionist players upon release.

Replay Viewer: Missions can be replayed using a viewer that is accessible in the main menu. This viewer allows for players to change camera aperture settings, color grading settings, focal length, spline paths, and speed. A timeline also exists which can be scrubbed back and forth.

New Character Customization: Allows players to change boots, shirts, pants, armor, gloves, wristwear, heads, tattoos, voices, face-wear, NVGs, gas masks, and helmets (along with mod support for players).
New Characters Added: Over 175 new characters have been added to the game for suspects, civilians, and other NPCs.

Overhauled Visual Effects: All visual effects have been completely redone. This includes 3D muzzle flashes, impact effects, spalling, destruction, flashbangs, cs gas, pepper spray, OC launcher impacts, tracers, C2 breaches, and much more.
Tip Screens for new players in the Los Suenos Police Station. Information about new unlocks will also be able to be seen here.
Replaced a large number of placeholder assets with more bespoke, custom assets with better optimization.
Headcam perspective now includes the officer’s helmet.
Low Ready Toggle: New options to set high and low ready.
New Death Animations: added 100+ death animations (different limbs, arterial bleeds, etc.)
Quantum Sound Manager: New system that supports accurate reflections for sound and better simulated occlusion, leading to a more realistic experience when trying to locate targets.
New distance layers for gunshots: Allows for a nicer transition as enemies get closer while shooting.
New OSTs added: Plenty of new soundtracks for your listening pleasure.
New Sound Design Pass: All levels (old and new) have received improvements to their sound design
New SWAT Voices: 13 uniquely voiced, studio-quality voice lines for different tactical officers operating in the LSPD.
New Suspect and Civilian Voices: Fully added all remaining voice lines for key characters across each level, with over 50,000 voice lines across more than 120 characters.
New MCX Assault Rifle
New LVAR Assault Rifle
New F90 Assault Rifle
New SuperbNova Shotgun
New UMP-9 SMG
New TLE-1911 Pistol
New TPL Less Lethal Launcher
New X2 Taser
Overhauled 870MCS Breaching Shotgun
Overhauled UMP-45 SMG
Overhauled M45A1 Pistol
Overhauled MPX SMG
Added MK18 Training Version for Tutorial Level
Added G19 Training Version for Tutorial Level
New Main Menu presentation
New Settings Menu presentation
Customization and Loadout Screen Overhauled
Pause Menu Overhauled
Mod.io changed to use a native explorer which has more options (e.g. search by categories)
Added support for subtitles: Shows real-time transcripts of voice lines said in-game.
Colourblind options for protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia.
Item Highlight: Item highlights can be enabled for an easier time when finding evidence
Localization additions: New language support for in-game texts.
New Map: “Elephant”, an active-shooter mission at a college campus.
New Map: “Rust Belt”, a raid set on the border of Los Sueños and Tijuana.
New Map: “Sins”, a high-stakes hostage situation in the upper floors of an old hotel.
New Map: “Streamer”, a hostage situation occurring in an apartment complex.
New Map: “Beachfront”, a warrant service on a house near Los Sueños' coastline.
New Map: “Training”, an introductory space to players new to Ready or Not or who need a refresher

New Map: “Station” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. It includes new spaces such as an improved training area, shooting range with working targets, evidence room, and minigame (although you’ll have to search the halls for this one).
New Map: “Carriers of the Vine” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. Raid a cultist compound and uncover its secrets.
New Map: “Hide and Seek” has been completely recreated from the ground-up. Go head-to-head against a large international criminal operation.
Complete Redesign: “Buy Cheap, Buy Twice” has been recreated almost entirely.
If you are running mods, there will be a new “safe launch” option in case any existing mods are crashing the game.

Overhauled all suspect and civilian AI: This has been done across all levels to make them feel unique to each situation. There are many new details that should allow the AI to appear more intelligent, as well as some unique tells that may give players insight into a situation before they spot any threats. Some of these include:
Optimization Pass: Many levels have received a pass on their optimization, which should result in a solid FPS on most hardware. Other optimizations include:
Ammunition Overhaul: Ammunition has been updated for all weapons, and numerous bugs have been obliterated in the wake of this new set of changes:
Armor Improvements:
Penetration Overhaul: We have now made several significant improvements, including:
Overhauled Loadout Menu: The new loadout menu provides more insight into item selection, less nested menus, and a simpler way of navigating around different areas.
Ready Up is now done through pressing “Y” by default.

Chemical Agents Improvements: Rebalance, redesign, and refactor of the chemical-based weapons and tools in the game to be more fun and in-depth. Chemical Agents refer to all chemical-based weapons and tools and grenades in the game: CS Gas, OC Balls, Pepperspray.

tags.balance_change: Ability to pick which mission type to play a level on has been removed due to limitations with design and testing, and to avoid narrative conflicts.
“Valley / Dealer / Penthouse have all been updated so their OSTs are more dynamic (combat comes in more gradually / certain sections “unlock” once certain things happen)
Slug rounds for shotguns will now penetrate most surfaces, as well as up to level 3 armor. They will also ricochet more.
Buckshot and some other rounds will have a chance to severely dismember targets.
Re-balanced the damage and armor penetration for each ammunition type to make them more logically consistent and each round more uniquely purposed.
Armor is now more consistent in gameplay. Incoming rounds will be blocked based on the direction the player is facing, not their 3d model.
Ceramic now has higher durability, but can still break and loses effectiveness with repeated impacts. Don't get blasted by a shotgun.
Bullets will do less damage depending on the amount of energy left in the round (eg. shooting through several sheets of plywood will reduce the bullet damage)
Flesh is now less easy to penetrate so JHP rounds are more likely to function as intended.
Shooting an enemy through two legs used to do the same amount of damage as the bullet made two different impacts on the same target. Now, it will do reduced damage on the second (and third) hit.
AI will attempt to flee areas that are affected by OC.
AI will stumble and move away from OC when hit by it.
Suspects that are pepper sprayed can still shoot you, but are blinded.
CS Gas will seep out of open doorways and around corners.

Fine tuning of “stress” system: allow for positive feedback loop when playing using less-lethal weapons. Suspects (on levels where appropriate) will be more likely to hesitate at low stress levels. Stress increases as more firefights and other loud noises occur.
Use of Force Continnium (aka RoE in-game) has been made more lenient for hostile situations.

tags.bug: Gameplay Improvements: Level design across all levels has been improved, fixing holes in walls and navigation for AI which would often lead to players being shot through walls and floors. Similarly, navigation through some areas has been adjusted so that it becomes more obvious where players need to go.
“Thank You, Come Again” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.

“A Lethal Obsession” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
“Greased Palms” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
“Sinuous Trail” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
“The Spider” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
“Valley of the Dolls” has received gameplay improvements to spawns, civilian and suspect AI, objectives, collision, performance, and visibility.
Fixed issue where some weapons had the wrong ammunition tag, causing it to use default penetration values.
A large number of bugs related to penetration have now been resolved, as well as several large oversights to do with materials that could not be penetrated.

notes.title: Vol.65 - Ready or Not Development Briefing
notes.content:
[b][h1]Attention Officers, [/h1][/b]
Thank you for joining us for the 65th edition of our biweekly development briefing, December 1st, 2023! 
 
Today we are going to go over some of the great work that’s gone into new weapons that have been added to the game, including the [b]MCX rifle, LVAR rifle, F90 rifle, Supernova shotgun, UMP-9 SMG, TLE 1911,[/b] and the [b]TPL less-lethal launcher. [/b]

Redone weapon models, covered after, are the breaching shotgun which is now an [b]870MCS, the M45A1 pistol, UMP45 SMG, and the MPX SMG.[/b]

Throughout we'll [b]show and discuss much of the new gunshot and foley (handling) audio[/b] that has been added with most of the weapons above.

Lastly, we’ll take a look at re-worked [b]ammunition values and penetration system[/b]. Revealed in this section is [b]new training ammunition[/b] for use in training areas only, with a [b]corresponding custom training MK18 rifle and G19 pistol.[/b]
 
[b]Also, as you may have noticed from [url=https://x.com/VOIDInteractive/status/1730270617524465988?s=20]our post from on X[/url] yesterday, you can expect a big announcement from us at The Game Awards this December 7th! [/b]
 
[i][u][b]Please keep in mind that the development content depicted in this briefing is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the game’s final state. [/b][/u][/i]
 
[i]Vol.65 Development Briefing [b]summary points[/b]: [/i]
[i][u][b](not a changelog) [/b][/u][/i]
[b]—[/b] New weapons:
- MCX rifle 
- LVAR rifle 
- F90 rifle 
- Supernova shotgun 
- UMP9 SMG 
- TLE 1911 pistol 
- TPL Less-Lethal launcher   
[b]—[/b] Redone weapon models:
- 870MCS Breaching Shotgun 
- UMP45 SMG 
- M45A1 pistol 
- MPX SMG 
[b]—[/b] Weapon audio matches the furniture of a weapon (how it is constructed, such as stocks and rails). E.g. the MCX and LVAR have different foley audio since they’re constructed of different components despite being on the same MCX platform.
[b]—[/b] Reworked realistic ammunition values, including new tissue damage, armor penetration, cover penetration, spalling, and ricochet values. Engine blocks of vehicles now block ammo as a reflection of the detailed rework to cover penetration.
[b]—[/b] (For use in Training Areas only) New training ammo for the new designated blue furnished training MK18 and Glock19 models.
- New Training MK18 rifle (Blue) (Training areas only) 
- New Training G19 pistol (Blue) (Training areas only) 

 
[h2][i][u][b]New Weapons and Audio: [/b][/u][/i][/h2]

The new weapons listed below are the [b]MCX, LVAR, F90, TLE 1911, UMP9,[/b] and [b]TPL Pepperball Launcher.[/b]
 
As always, our audio design team has been hard at work crafting the most impactful authentic muzzle reports and foley possible. We have also made a major audio pass to distant gunshots across the board. 
 
The videos below feature weapon audio and the new models alike to give you an idea of what your arsenal will look and sound like.  

 
[h3][u][b]MCX: [/b][/u][/h3]
 
In game description: “Highly popular with modern police tactical units all over the world, the [b]MCX [/b]platform [could be considered as] slowly taking over the AR15 in terms of modularity, performance, and customization.”  
 
[i]“The MCX chambered in 5.56x45mm shares a similar resemblance to the one used by the CTSFO (the UK’s Counter Terrorist police unit), featuring an 11.5” barrel, a collapsing/telescoping stock, a custom charging handle, and a keymod handguard outfitted with side and lower rail sections for use with accessories. This rifle build was in the style of a traditional MCX, more alike the ones from the 1st generation.” [/i]
 
The MCX’s fantastic modularity is represented by the LVAR weapon we will discuss next. 
 
[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the new MCX during a magazine check) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/e6ddb1aa95d89f309ce376184d8cc0f90d2a7a77.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of firing the new MCX indoors and outdoors)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=YWw0MxUy3i4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u][b]LVAR: [/b][/u][/h3]
 
The [in-game [b]LVAR [/b](or the Low Visibility Assault Rifle)] is chambered in .300 Blackout and is the first weapon in the game to be integrally suppressed. With .300 Blackout being a sizeable subsonic round, this rifle is an excellent combination of stealth and hard-hitting capability in a short-barrel configuration.  
 
The LVAR is inspired by the LVAW (Low Visibility Assault Weapon) but ours notably uses “an MCX gen 1 upper and gen 2 lower, with the rest being LVAW parts” 
 
Compared to the MCX, the platform it is built on, the LVAR is equipped with a unique folding stock, handguard, and upper/lower receiver, as well as many parts that were developed especially for the rifle. Due to the LVAR being only marketed towards law enforcement/military applications, it serves as a perfect rifle addition for the LSPD’s arsenal. 
 
[i]“Initial development proposals were to add [just] one MCX platform rifle chambered in 5.56 ammo only, but because of the modular nature of the weapon, it wasn’t too difficult to reconfigure a second MCX-style rifle to fire .300 Blackout, which is [what is known in-game as the LVAR.]” [/i]
 
[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the new LVAR during a magazine check) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/068a12d44d845df0aa3548d92af2804bef80924c.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of firing the new LVAR indoors and outdoors)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=m6XWNcMOA08;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u][b]F90: [/b][/u][/h3]
 
The [b]F90 [/b]is the game’s first bullpup-style rifle, featuring a barrel and magazine set further back than other conventional rifles to reduce overall weapon length. This new addition delivers you rifle caliber power in a compact state-of-the art package, a further iteration of the AUG rifle design that it is similar to. 
 
[i]“There were several suggestions on what the first bullpup rifle would be for the game. While the Austrian AUG was considered, the rail space was too limited, and it had a special progressive trigger feature to switch between semi and full auto which would have been troublesome to put in the game. 
  
Ultimately, the F90 was chosen because it solved a lot of the problems we had with the AUG. The F90 has a simple selector switch (a tiny tab that sticks out that prevents the trigger from being pulled all the way through, effectively semi-auto), plenty of rail space which also allows the use of grip attachments, and the added benefit of being able to use STANAG magazines.” [/i]
 
[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the new F90 during a magazine check) [/u][/i]
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/33583d37a26534e33308983b672769ccaf2cefd3.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of the new F90 firing indoors and outdoors) [/u][/i]
 [previewyoutube=sNq1wwY9gGo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u][b]Supernova [/b][/u][/h3]

Shown below is the brand new pump action Supernova shotgun, loaded in 12 gauge, equally devastating as it is alluring.

[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the new Supernova shotgun)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90264d2c8c75fd275f4bedff1b1b9c020de8dfbf.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some of the audio from the new Supernova shotgun firing indoors and outdoors)
[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=vIBeHx9QMnk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u][b]TLE 1911: [/b][/u][/h3]
 
[i]“During the development of the new Police Station, a memorial was made for a decorated SWAT member who used a custom 1911 that became the [b]TLE 1911[/b]. [Although] initially the TLE 1911 was supposed to be a prop weapon for the station, it is now its own useable pistol in-game.” [/i]
  
The new TLE 1911 pistol is custom ordered for the LSPD including an all-black finish, putting a twist on the classic beauty and functionality of this pistol into your officer’s hands.  
 
This weapon has unique foley (general handling audio like reloads) different from its modernized cousin in the game, the M45A1. The original foley audio for the new 1911 was sourced from a 1911 Hardballer, which, fun fact, was stylized like the iconic Silverballer. 
 
[i]“Compared to the M45A1, the TLE1911 [also] has taller iron sights, a shorter beaver tail, and a full-length recoil guide rod. Because of this 1911’s non-railed frame, the TLE has a set of unique and classic attachments not shared with the M45A1.” [/i]
 
[i][u](Image below: In-game replay photo of the sleek new TLE 1911 in all of its glory)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/bd96501392f8ec72a0f283a058c7d094e0e96bfb.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of firing the new TLE 1911 indoors and outdoors)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=SdeUolR1JvE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b][u]UMP9: [/u][/b][/h3]
 
This variant of the UMP is chambered in 9mm ammo, allowing for more controllable recoil and 5 more rounds in the magazine than the UMP45.  
 
What was already one of the most controllable SMGs in the game becomes surgically accurate with minimal effort considering its relatively low cyclic fire rate.  
 
The [b]UMP9[/b] needs to be converted internally in order to be chambered in 9mm, with this weapon featuring a different replaced barrel, bolt, and magazine. 

[i][u](Image below: In-game replay photo of the new UMP9, with the 9mm designation etched into its slide) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/1aabb34da06aaec9c8d736906ae3fc49632e9d44.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of the new UMP9 indoors and outdoors)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=8JHX9Ydb1Uo;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h3][u][b]TPL Pepperball Launcher: [/b][/u][/h3]
 
[i]“To coincide with the revamped pepper ball mechanic [that has more area denial capability from lasting pepper cloud impacts], a new shorter alternative to the R7, the [b]TPL launcher[/b] was added that you can use in super-tight spaces. While it does lack in ammo capacity, it does make up for it in reload speed.” [/i]
 
[i][u](Image below: In-game replay view of the new TPL pepperball launcher)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/9900945453ab1b494d4f7efc8303269295df3e08.jpg[/img]

 
[h2][i][u][b]Redone Weapon Models: [/b][/u][/i][/h2]
 
Many of our existing models have been redone to better suit our desires for quality and immersion. These redone models include the [b]870MCS Breaching Shotgun, MPX, UMP-45,[/b] and [b]M45A1. [/b]
 

[h3][u][b]870MCS Breaching Shotgun [/b][/u][/h3]
 
This new model for the breaching shotgun, the now [b]870MCS Breaching Shotgun[/b] has a much shorter barrel, a with specially shaped grip on the pump and an overall higher model fidelity.  
 
[i][u](Image below: In-game replay photo of the 870MCS Breaching Shotgun) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/5cdcb4e8490eb6d19b2da26fca2fc0fc80781808.jpg[/img]
[i][u](Video below: The 870MCS shotgun in use)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=cCkQhvCP-K8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][u][b]M45A1 [/b][/u][/h3]
 
The [b]M45A1 [/b]was a model that benefited greatly from a remodel, for its previous version was generally too large and suffered from culling issues where the user’s hand would clip through the model.  
 
This new version brings the scale into a more accurate level and showcases fine enhancements to its visuals. New foley audio has also been added for weapon handling. 
 
[i][u](image below: In-game replay photo of the remodeled M45A1)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/63122f1f2205e8fc166e383138922aca8f559fe8.jpg[/img]
 

[h3][u][b]UMP-45 [/b][/u][/h3]
 
Here is the enhanced remodel of our [b]UMP45[/b]. The video below serves to compare the handling and audio with the new UMP9.

[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the remodeled UMP45)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/d23fb014f6d3857ec909820fedae4196907212aa.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some audio of the new UMP45 to compare with the new UMP9)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=pwbADUgS7Hs;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][u][b]MPX [/b][/u][/h3]

The redone [b]MPX [/b]has improved fidelity in addition to new gunfire audio.

[i][u](Image below: An in-game replay photo of the remodeled MPX)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/725175491fc68cd7b2e985b7bbc60b367c1dd66c.png[/img]
[i][u](Video below: Some of the new audio of the remodeled MPX)[/u][/i]
[previewyoutube=kZTCoA_qRxo;full][/previewyoutube]
 
[h2][i][u][b]Ammunition Rework [/b][/u][/i][/h2]
 
Our ammo damage and penetration values have been[b] revamped across all ammo types in order to provide more realistic gameplay.[/b] We based how much armor-defeating capability certain rounds should have based on their rated effectiveness against real-world tiers of ballistic armor. The variables of [b]armor penetration, penetration distance, tissue damage, spalling, and ricochet potential are all now represented more appropriately across each ammo type. [/b]
 
An example of some of the immersive changes to cover penetration is how the[b] engine block on vehicles will now appropriately shield[/b] you from incoming fire: 
 
[i][u](GIF below: The rounds fired at the engine block of this vehicle deflect or are absorbed, providing you with a realistic level of hard cover in firefights. Park your feet with care.)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/2a26bc9b8c7f8983adfb91201ee7a26c33a91858.gif[/img]

Last but not least, we now have [b]training ammunition[/b] which is only able to be used in training areas with designated training weapons. Those [b]designated training weapons take the form of a custom blue furnished MK18 rifle and G19 pistol.[/b] This ammo in its early state currently functions like an extremely weak rifle cartridge, however this will likely be improved upon in the future.
 
[i][u](Image below: In-game replay photos of the special blue training MK18 rifle and G19 pistol with their exclusively designated training ammo visible loaded in the magazines. This development screenshot is not taken within a training area, however it will only be usable in training areas in-game.)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/3392288ceb85c45de335967d7bfa573bead76137.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/141d974a3964c96920948dbf493b723f529b5d26.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]Conclusion  [/h1]
  
Hopefully this newsletter can help you prepare your favorite in-game loadout ideas for 1.0 and our future updates. [b]Speaking of which, we’re still on track to have the 1.0 release out to you before the end of this year! [/b]
 
Before we go, one last bit of intel, 
 
[i][u][Image below: A view of part of the new gore system in-game. The impacts of harmful actions are looking a bit more serious, make sure you’re sure before taking the shot] [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/663d8e067afbf90cd3c9d438329a0a780b7e1048.png[/img]
 
This concludes our 65th development briefing. Be sure to tune in next time for more development news! 

[i]Thank you to our wildly talented weapon modelers and audio designers who provided insights to this development briefing, as well as Hunter for the hard-hitting GIF of bullet penetration.[/i]
 
Are you a content creator on YouTube or Twitch looking for new games? We've got you covered; Ready or Not has partnered with Lurkit to elevate gameplay!  
[b]Link up with our Lurkit campaign [url=https://www.lurkit.com/games/ready-or-not/videos]here![/url] [/b]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90eea2aeb7449fef24bf55b66fe1bc4c923c6b69.jpg[/img]
 
[b]Make sure you follow Ready or Not on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/]here![/url]
Our other links: [url=https://discord.gg/readyornot]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/voidinteractive]X[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj3qNoOLkzHJ60vxG6xQvlA]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/void_interactive/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/VOIDInteractive/]Facebook[/url]. notes.title: Vol.64 - Ready or Not Development Briefing
notes.content:
[h1][b]Attention Officers, [/b][/h1]

Thank you for joining us for the 64th edition of our biweekly development briefing, November 17th, 2023! 

Today our [b]newly overhauled SWAT AI teammates[/b] make their proper debut as an advanced and intuitive critical feature to the game.

With this development on SWAT AI we’ve made a major step towards continuing our vision for what [i]Ready or Not[/i] can be— a quintessential tactical shooter with a central focus on PvE that’s worthy of a SWAT experience.

Let us walk you through an overview of the [b]vast new capabilities[/b] this SWAT AI system will provide, including [b]huge improvements and additions[/b] for [b]formations, stacking, breaching, clearing, callouts, and securing.[/b]

[b][u][i]Please keep in mind that the development content depicted in this briefing is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the game’s final state. [/i][/u][/b]

[i]Vol.64 Development Briefing [b]summary points:[/b][/i]
[u][b][i](not a changelog) [/i][/b][/u]
- 4 different fall-in formations for SWAT AI, including single file, double file, diamond, and wedge 
- SWAT AI can adjust their formation based on the obstacles around them
- Ability to micromanage how your officers stack up, including left, right, split, and swapping positions of specific officers 
- SWAT AI can automatically adjust their positioning in a stack according to the room layout or their equipment 
- SWAT AI have voice callouts for open doorways, suspect actions, and more 
- Vastly improved, realistic clearing tactics for SWAT AI that incorporates many techniques such as dynamic and limited penetration clearing
- Improved SWAT AI usage of less-lethal weapons against suspects
- SWAT AI automatically secures and reports civilians and suspects or DOAs
- SWAT AI automatically secures evidence and has more commands to make evidence collection much more streamlined
- SWAT AI can use the door ram and grenade launchers for breaching
- SWAT AI automatically swaps to their secondary weapon when out of primary weapon ammo, and can fire in semi-auto to conserve ammo when appropriate
- Improved grenade deployment accuracy for SWAT AI
- Teaser conclusion


[i][u][b][h2]Falling In [/h2][/b][/u][/i]
Your SWAT AI teammates can now fall into [b]specific formations[/b], allowing you to fine-tune your officers' movement through a given tactical environment. These 4 fall-in formations are described as single file, double file, diamond, and wedge. When ordering your SWAT members to Hold a position they will properly maintain the formation they were in. 

[i][u](Image below: The new fall in command menu) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/79842d0f2a6c1ac9ecab638a355b40d62b54c6cd.png[/img]

In all of these formations your SWAT AI will strive to maintain their respective angles to create a broad scan of their surroundings with minimal redundant overlap. 

Officers in the back of a formation will pull rear security to ensure your flanks are covered. 

They will automatically adjust their formation in order to logically accommodate the space they’re in, for example switching from double file to single file or fluidly navigating obstacles.  

[i][u](GIF below: SWAT AI automatically shifting from double file to single file formation to account for obstacles)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/607510c1f71c6bdc6feb40f635ed052e0c6515cd.gif[/img]

Single file is useful for extremely claustrophobic spaces such as a tunnel.  Officers in the middle of the formation will watch left/right. Single file exposes a minimal number of officers to forward facing threats but entails less forward coverage.

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI in single file cover their angles while moving through a cellar)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/bf3adb147bd024450da92004547e7163404d9f26.gif[/img]

In double file, you are positioned at the point of the two columns, with the officers on your right and left watching the front and those in the back watching the rear. Double file is particularly effective for medium width hallways that have high potential for threats in the front and rear.  

[i][u](GIF below: SWAT AI clearing a hallway while in double file formation)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/92a40d797755674b21d93187be701beb4e914628.gif[/img]

Diamond formation is beneficial for moving through a space with many openings where potential threats are surrounding you. In open spaces it prioritizes a 360 degrees breadth of coverage over concentrated firepower. In closed spaces it operates similar to double file but with less emphasized rear coverage. 

[i][u](GIF below: SWAT AI in diamond formation clearing a parking lot)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/65a079e4e383456d25ec80113b48400e3daf9a93.gif[/img]

Last but not least, wedge formation allows you to spread out over an area with a high amount of concentrated focus forward. Officers in this formation will behave similarly to double file except more spread out. Use this formation to overwhelm a specific threat or flank enemies who are using cover.


[u][i][h2]Stacking Up[/h2][/i][/u]
You now have the ability to micromanage your stack in careful combinations as you approach your breaches. Choose which side of the threshold (e.g. door or hallway opening) that you want your team to stack on, split the stack, or even order individual officers to swap places with one another.

[i][u](GIF below: The new stack up command menu)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/2f13060bb8f5c735ea683bcc83c81abe8e6938d2.png[/img]

Utilize this granularity of stacking styles to prevent officers from being exposed to threats based on the layout of the space and to tailor the approach of your entry into the next space. 

Have an officer with a shield? Perhaps put them at the front of the stack, however they can also do this autonomously. Is an officer more injured than another? Consider sending your injured officer towards the rear of a stack. 

Are you anticipating long range threats or close-range threats, is less-lethal appropriate, how claustrophobic is the next space, and what’s the risk of bullet over-penetration? No problem. Choose officers with the appropriate weapon systems and loadouts to be near the front of the stack to immediately confront these scenarios. 

[i][u](GIF below: Ordering specific SWAT AI in a stack to switch places)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/39e6da25420fcf03f1a28204d2cc34c8f5405d2d.gif[/img]

However, you don't need to concern yourself too much with these variables, your SWAT AI will strive to intuitively stack up in an appropriate manner for a given room; albeit they do not have nearly as much tactical planning responsibility as you do as their commander. 


[b][u][i][h2]Breaching[/h2][/i][/u][/b]
Take advantage of updated breaching styles for SWAT AI, including door rams, 40mm launchers, and leader breaches. The addition of these options for SWAT AI makes them more on par with the versatility of human players. 

[u][i](Images below: The new breaching command menu, the Battering Ram and Leader breach options are now added)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/0a60a398acf5de4857206327c5991e3f3ac77b97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/599a9e64fe00e31ee22795dec85d85d74069ca60.png[/img]

Among other breaching improvements, they are now capable of busting down a door with a swift swing of a ram or narrowly peaking to pop a 40mm launcher less-lethal munition round into a room. With the tactical intuition prompted by the “leader” breach command, they can comprehend and follow up your own equipment usage (e.g. grenade throw, battering ram, C2) or your movement into the threshold to breach seamlessly with you. 

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI following a "Clear with Leader" command, where the player deploys a flashbang before they enter) [/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/70306fda001dea7d8d5ae3c90c19a63b4a1e12c4.gif[/img]

In general, SWAT AI breaching consistency has been improved overall, with more accurate grenade throws being another inclusion.  


[i][u][h2]Callouts and Clearing[/h2] [/u][/i]
Despite such nuanced control you have over almost every tactical facet of your SWAT AI officers, you should also know that they are tactical professionals, effectively fully functional on an autonomous level as well.  

They don’t require constant commands or handholding. They will make callouts, move, prioritize contacts in a room in accordance with your orders, lean around corners, stay alert to openings, make arrests, check hiding places, and more based on their own astute tactical awareness. 

[u][i](GIFs below: SWAT AI smoothly leaning around a wide variety of obstacles to better clear the niches in an area)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/1adc020a2d317b65902f2a065f39cfe20bf12696.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/4cc64cfe4eabdbea57cb38bdad7fd901db82098a.gif[/img]

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI performing a special animation to check a potential hiding spot under a table)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/ffe431c751ed1e5ec8d7483e69f17a23f3c4b820.gif[/img]

Still, they display steadfast obedience to orders and will stop or change what they are doing when requested. 

Before and during a clearing SWAT AI will verbally make note of doors/thresholds they see, if they are open, how many, and in what direction. Furthermore, upon spotting an unarmed suspect pull a weapon they will ensure you are aware, with the “Gun!” and “Knife!” voice lines for scenarios teetering on the edge. 

Your officers will flow into the room with precision confidence during dynamic entries corresponding to their initial stack setup, alternating entry directions, checking corners, filling the space, calling for compliance, and prioritizing threats. 

Officers can also be ordered to use limited penetration (aka ‘slice-based’) CQB clearing techniques such as ‘pieing’ a threshold. When an officer is ordered to ‘pie’ a threshold they will gradually lean and move until they can view a substantial slice of what’s past the threshold. In certain scenarios these techniques can minimize immediate harm to your officers and provide a reactive perception of what’s beyond the threshold.  
 
These two above styles of clearing, dynamic and limited penetration, can easily be combined together when clearing. 

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI 'pieing' a threshold before performing a dynamic entry)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/ba4ac2fa549f077a1b637579c5ba1c79e98787bb.gif[/img]

While firefights are ringing out, your officer is not down when they run out ammo on their primary. They will immediately transition to their appropriate secondary weapon and continue engaging any threats as necessary, then switch back to primary when the immediate threat is dealt with. To prevent ammo from running out in the first place your officers can now switch fire modes to semi-automatic on select fire weapons.  

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI automatically swapping between their primary and secondary weapon to engage a threat when out of primary weapon ammo)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/03a9769beae90ffdf50b5fe511e329e384f47707.gif[/img]


[u][i][h2]Securing the Scene[/h2] [/i][/u]
The increased autonomy of your SWAT AI is perhaps most convenient for how they are able to skillfully secure a scene without needing your direct input. This assistance makes your job a lot less tedious so you can focus on dealing with other tactical situations. 

[i][u](GIF below: SWAT AI officers automatically securing a weapon and reporting a dead individual)[/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/183d84bc4ffb58884dcfe2445afee471fc5f217d.gif[/img]

SWAT AI's enhanced ability to autonomously secure suspects also makes their usage of less lethal equipment more viable than before, wherein now they will promptly pursue securing their target in a safe manner following suspect compliance.  

[u][i](GIF below: SWAT AI officers automatically securing a civilian)[/i][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/3da177f99494cd70e9a52328f27c23f533111a3f.gif[/img]

[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
 
With our overhauled SWAT AI teammates, playing ‘solo’ has never been a more seamless teamwork-oriented experience. We're thrilled with how the SWAT AI functions right now, and you can expect to see even more improvements such as SWAT AI animation upgrades post 1.0.
 
Prepare for entry, because we’re currently on track to release 1.0 before the end of the year. 
 
[i]Before we sign off, here’s a bit more intel: [/i]
 
[i][u](GIF below: An in-game replay view of our revamped Supporter Edition Exclusive FISA HRT officer outfit and its exclusive tan GPNVGs) [/u][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/87e94229bc9a7564febbf1a721dea6340496b15f.gif[/img]

This concludes our 64th development briefing. Be sure to tune in next time for more development news! 

[i]Thank you to Ali for his hard work and providing these fantastic GIFs of the SWAT AI system.[/i]

Are you a content creator on YouTube or Twitch looking for new games? We've got you covered; Ready or Not has partnered with Lurkit to elevate gameplay!  [b]Link up with our Lurkit campaign [url=https://www.lurkit.com/games/ready-or-not/videos]here[/url]. [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36750080/90eea2aeb7449fef24bf55b66fe1bc4c923c6b69.jpg[/img]
[b]Make sure you follow Ready or Not on Steam [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144200/Ready_or_Not/]here[/url]. 
Our other links: [url=https://discord.com/invite/readyornot]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/voidinteractive]X[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCj3qNoOLkzHJ60vxG6xQvlA]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/void_interactive/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/VOIDInteractive/]Facebook[/url]. [/b]

[h3][b]Stack up and clear out. [/b]
[i]VOID Interactive[/i] [/h3]
